name: VIRYA 22 — AI Content Studio — Drive Fixed

nodes.name: Mon/Wed/Fri — content studio 13:30
nodes.notes: Light runtime cadence: 0 30 13 * * 1,3,5 (Europe/Warsaw). Workflow logic and data mappings unchanged.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ ({ content: String(('AI Content Studio: ' + ($json.reason || 'brak nowego materiału')) ?? '').slice(0, 2000), allowed_mentions: ($json.allowed_mentions && typeof $json.allowed_mentions === 'object') ? $json.allowed_mentions : { parse: [] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $json.analysisPrompt }, { inlineData: { mimeType: $json.mimeType, data: $json.base64 } }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.35, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $json.imagePrompt }, { inlineData: { mimeType: $json.mimeType, data: $json.base64 } }] }], generationConfig: { responseModalities: ['TEXT','IMAGE'], imageConfig: { aspectRatio: '4:5', imageSize: '1K' } } }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const src = $('Extract Processed Image').first().json;
const uploaded = items[0]?.json || {};
const plan = src.plan;
const now = new Date();
const itemId = `SOC-${now.toISOString().replace(/[-:.TZ]/g,'').slice(0,14)}-${String(src.assetId).slice(-4)}`;
const derivativeId = uploaded.id || uploaded.fileId || uploaded.data?.id || '';
const derivativeUrl = uploaded.webViewLink || (derivativeId ? `https://drive.google.com/file/d/${derivativeId}/view` : '');
return [{json:{
  Item_ID:itemId,
  Created_At:now.toISOString(),
  Source:'AI_CONTENT_STUDIO',
  Asset_Name:src.derivativeFileName,
  Asset_URL:derivativeUrl,
  Asset_Drive_ID:derivativeId,
  Content_Type:plan.content_type || 'POST',
  Topic:plan.topic,
  Hook:plan.hook,
  On_Screen_Text:'',
  Caption_PL:plan.caption_pl,
  CTA:plan.cta,
  Hashtags:plan.hashtags,
  Suggested_Publish_At:plan.suggested_publish_at,
  Channels:plan.channels || 'INSTAGRAM+FACEBOOK',
  Status:'READY_FOR_APPROVAL',
  Approval_Note:`AI quality score: ${plan.quality_score ?? ''}. Original: ${src.originalUrl}`,
  Published_At:'',
  IG_Media_ID:'',
  FB_Post_ID:'',
  Error:'',
  Source_URLs:src.originalUrl,
  skipWrite:'FALSE',
  altText:plan.alt_text,
  originalAssetId:src.assetId,
  derivativeId,
  derivativeUrl
}}];
